Proposes building the Flagsmith SDK at new versions. **Merging this leads to a release tag** once CI confirms the merge on `main`.

| Dimension | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Flagsmith provider | `${OLD_PROVIDER}` | `${PROVIDER}` |
| Bridge plugin | `${OLD_BRIDGE}` | `${BRIDGE}` |
| Pulumi CLI | | `${PULUMI_CLI}` |

Both the `pins.yml` bump and the generated SDK are in this one commit, so the
declaration and the artifact can never disagree.

## Verification

`scripts/gate.sh` — the same gate `ci.yml` runs — passed in [the workflow run
that produced this PR](${RUN_URL}), **before** the PR existed: regeneration,
`patch-sdk.sh`, `repackage.sh` (which asserts the `pulumi.parameterization`
block), build, pins/artifact agreement, the runtime smoke test and the consumer
smoke test. Its result is stamped on this commit as the `regenerate-gate` status.

> [!NOTE]
> `ci.yml` does not start on this PR: GitHub does not trigger workflows for
> events caused by the default `GITHUB_TOKEN`. For an independent re-run on a
> fresh runner, **close and reopen this PR** — a human reopening does trigger it.

## After merging

Once CI passes on `main`, `tag.yml` cuts `v${PROVIDER}-sdk.<n>`. Consumers pin it:

```bash
npm install github:${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}#v${PROVIDER}-sdk.1
```
